verdict.rationale: Gusto documents invoice ingestion: it reads an uploaded invoice and prefills the paysheet for review and approval (gusto-docs-8). This directly matches the read-a-bill, auto-populate, human-review loop, but it appears scoped to paying contractors through payroll (gusto-docs-7) rather than general accounts-payable bills. missing for 10: evidence that it handles general vendor or utility bills beyond contractor paysheets, explicit description of AI/OCR extraction depth, automatic intake of incoming bills (not just manual upload), independent or hands-on corroboration.
